verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for an incident-management SaaS, but the evidence pack documents no bulk data export, export formats, or offboarding path. The REST API (docs-21, docs-93) is only a developer building block from which an export could be built. The Signals Migrator (docs-22) imports PagerDuty and Opsgenie configs into FireHydrant, which is the opposite direction from leaving.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
